_comment: Corrections to a food bank's own pin when Give Food lists a postal address instead of where food is given out. Checked on the food bank's own site. Applied by scripts/classify.py on every build. Stale pins listed in _remove_ids are dropped.

littlehampton-district.evidence: Food bank's own site: 'FOODBANK CENTRE ADDRESS: Rear hall, Littlehampton United Church, BN17 5EG' (Tue, Thu); 'POSTAL ADDRESS: Littlehampton Baptist Church, BN17 5NY'. Dean (local) confirms it is not an admin office, 21 Oct 2026.
